title: Tattoos and such
content: I have a few random dreamscapes I haven't seen mentioned (as much). The doctors office. Compared to everything else in my mw it's tiny. I always see the same two nurses, no matter what I'm there for. There are sometimes endless hallways. But overall it's one of my most intimate places. They also offer tattoos. Does anyone else have mallword tattoos? Outside of the casino/ amusement park area. I spend a lot of time here. There are some great underground hangouts. The hotels can get disorienting so be awear you might not make it back.
